available_sources: Google Patents public result metadata via browser
current corpus and prior provenance artifacts

initial_frontier.selection_rule: candidate paths are generated from observed density, co-occurrence, negative evidence, source gaps and prior query outcomes; no technology is preselected
candidate_signals: dense organism/application intersections in the normalized corpus
bridges between agricultural use and industrial bioprocess terms
co-occurrences with weak source coverage or unresolved entity linkage
prior queries that died, returned noise, or produced an identifier/entity capable of a narrower follow-up
application/regulatory signals without a corresponding technical chain

stop_policy: stop a branch after two consecutive no-gain results
stop when a result cannot produce a more specific or decision-relevant next question
stop if the next action would require private data, full text, or a source outside the declared boundary
preserve parked and blocked branches as results
